title: Quenched Jamaican Grape Leaf Wrap
description: A fermented, creamy, crowd‑pleaser Jamaican wrap featuring grape leaves, grill, and gluten‑free-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: grape leaves
ingredients.notes: fresh or jarred, thawed if frozen

instructions: Rinse grape leaves under cold water, then blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds to soften and remove bitterness.
Meanwhile, combine coconut cream, jerk seasoning, minced garlic, chopped onion, lime juice, salt and pepper in a bowl; whisk until smooth.
Place a spoonful of the coconut mixture onto the center of each leaf, add a drizzle of fermented cabbage slaw, then roll leaf tightly and secure with a toothpick.
Preheat grill to medium‑high, brush leaves lightly with oil, and grill for 3‑4 minutes per side until leaves are charred and filling heated.
Remove from grill, let rest 2 minutes, then serve wrapped or chopped over a bed of fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
